I carry this ledger to record debts... People call me harsh, but I'm just doing my job. Yet, I remember Tomas... He never hid or lied. If he had no catch, he'd offer his labor instead.
Time erased more than unpaid accounts. It erased the truth of a father's sacrifice. Every time Tomas couldn't pay, he promised: 'When the season turns, I will settle everything.' And he meant it.
I came here expecting to collect money from an old fisherman... but looking at his humble home and the respect of his neighbors, I realize he was rich in things money can never buy.
Objects outlive numbers on a ledger. Small keepsakes left behind tell a deeper truth about Tomas than any debt list I hold.
I used to judge men by their payments. But Tomas taught me that an honest man's word and his love for his family are worth far more than copper coins.
